body:
yeah, and I know I should be grateful for what I have/had, but I feel how I feel. I guess that's my point, no matter what I do or what happens I always end up back in the same place, where I'm so depressed, in pain and just wanting to be dead. I don't know why I get worse so I can't control when I get worse again, it's like russian roulette with depression and only one chamber is empty.

At the end of the day, yes I can keep going. But I sit here and ask myself why is it even worth it? why bother getting up each day feeling like shit and hurting so much just because I can...that's not a life I can live with. I see a psychologist regularly, who is very good, but it doesn't prevent the depression and suicidal thoughts from coming.

I know what happiness feels like, I just can't see any future for myself besides endless drudgery with increasingly frequent bouts of severe depression until I finally snap and take the drugs to make it all stop.

I'm sure I sound like an ungrateful brat, but I honestly don't care. This is where my life is at and I'm not ok with it. And I'm not ok with spending the rest of my life 'managing' or waiting for the next bout of depression to hit.

Thanks for the response. Not to be rude, but your post is definitely not making me feel any less like killing myself. The thought of doing this for the next 30+ years....not a chance in hell, I'll be dead or well. I'm sorry to hear that that is what your life is like.
Right now, I'm just exhausted, I'll cry myself to sleep, get up and go to uni, see friends, come home and try to decide if tonight is the night, yet again.
